learner.scientific_constraint: Targets are used only after action selection to issue reward. The learner input contains only arbitrary fixed sparse symbol codes and slot position; no numeric magnitude or arithmetic result is supplied.

scientific_scope: Stage 3S removes dot perception entirely. Inputs are arbitrary fixed sparse codes for visible symbols; no scalar magnitude, ordinal embedding, sum, answer hint, or distance-to-answer feature is supplied. The external program knows the answer only to issue reward after the learner chooses an action. Frozen tests separately measure seen addition pairs, reversed operand order, and unordered pairs never rewarded during addition training. FlyWire coordinates remain visualization-only.
